Great food!
Jul 2018 • Business
There are only 2 dish to order here. 1. Grill pork and 2. Fried spring rolls which comes in like a cube. 
The grill pork is really delicious! It goes well with all the different kind of leaves on the table. Pour some fish sauce and put some papaya slices into your bowl. Add some noodles and pluck some leaves from the bunch and stir it in together with your noodles and fish sauce. Add that to a mouthful of grilled pork! and Viola!
Next, the cubic spring rolls with crab meat. It is rather heavy but they fried it so well.

Humongous Spring Roll
Feb 2017 • Friends
This is the place famous for their spring roll. It is squarish in shape and big! Each serving could serve 2 persons as they must cut up the spring roll into 4's and each cut up piece is equivalent to a normal size spring roll. It is delicious with the crab/shrimp filling and I imagine if you're hungry, you could polish off a whole one by yourself. But don't forget to also order their Bun Cha which includes 3 round pieces of pork sausage cake as well as 5 strips of pork bacon. When eaten with the white mong noodles and fish sauce, you'll be pretty full. Service is adequate and English comprehension is ok if you do not go beyond ordering menu items and asking for the bill.
